content: Emaho!In the western realm of Sukhāvatī,Stirred by the compassionate blessings of Amitābha,The nirmāṇakāya Padmasambhava was blessed,And came to Jambudvīpa for the benefit of beings.Possessor of compassion whose activity for beings is unceasing,I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.From the time of King Khri srong lde'u btsan onwards,Until the lineage of the Dharma Kings is no more,Grant your blessings unceasingly throughout the three times.Sole friend of the Dharma-protecting kings of Tibet,Compassionate one who guards the kings who practice Dharma,I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.Your physical form suppresses the rākṣasas of the southwest;With compassion, you behold the sentient beings of Tibet.Glorious guide for sentient beings lost in the darkness of ignorance,You skillfully tame those whose afflictions are difficult to subdue.Possessor of compassion whose loving affection flows without interruption,I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When the dregs of the degenerate age reach their ultimate limit,You come every morning and every evening for the sake of Tibet;You come riding upon the rays of the rising and setting sun,And on the tenth day of the waxing moon, you come in person.Compassionate one who performs great deeds for the benefit of beings,I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.In this final five-hundred-year period, the degenerate age of strife,All sentient beings are coarse with the five poisonous afflictions;They indulge in the five poisons of the afflictions in a chaotic and unrestrained manner.At such a time, Oḍḍiyāna, arouse your compassion;Compassionate one who leads the faithful to the higher realms,I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When surrounded by the terrifying armies of the Hor and others,And the sacred centers of Dharma are on the brink of destruction,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, together with your retinue of the eight classes of gods and demons,There is no doubt that you will repel the military forces.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When diseases arise that destroy the illusory bodies of sentient beings,And we are afflicted by the pain of unbearable suffering,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Since you, Oḍḍiyāna, are inseparable from the Medicine Buddha,You will certainly dispel all obstacles that are not the exhaustion of one's lifespan.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When the elements rise up as enemies and the vitality of the earth diminishes,And sentient beings are afflicted by the plague of famine,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, together with your assembly of ḍākinīs and wealth deities,There is no doubt that you will dispel poverty, hunger, and thirst.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When revealing treasures for the sake of fortunate beings,With the heroic confidence of a samaya free from all pretense,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Since you, Oḍḍiyāna, are inseparable from the yidam deity,There is no doubt that the son will receive the father’s inheritance.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When reaching secluded hermitages in the forests of hidden lands,If the path is blocked by swirling storms of rain and snow,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, together with your retinue of powerful local guardians,There is no doubt that you will lead the way for Dharma practitioners.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When traversing the terrifying narrow passes of the great wilderness,Where tigers, leopards, bears, and venomous fanged snakes roam,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, together with your heroes, ging, and protectors,There is no doubt that you will drive away these malicious beings.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When obstacles caused by the elements of earth, water, fire, and airReach the point of destroying this borrowed, illusory body,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, endowed with the heroes and the mighty,There is no doubt that you will pacify the elements into their own natural state.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When traveling along the narrow, perilous paths of the road,And threatened by murderous bandits and robbers,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, endowed with the realization of the four mudrās,You destroy the savage and predatory intent of those thieves.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When surrounded on all sides by the armies of executioners,And threatened by the striking of sharp weapons,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, endowed with the vajra pavilion,You cause the executioners to flee in terror and their weapons to be scattered.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When the time comes for this life to end and death to arrive,And I am endangered by the convergence of the agonizing pains of death,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, you are the emanation of Amitābha,And I shall certainly be born in the realm of Sukhāvatī.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.In the bardo where this borrowed illusory body disintegrates,When I am tormented by the great suffering of delusive appearances and further hallucinations,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, by the compassion of your knowledge of the three times,There is no doubt that delusive appearances are liberated into their own ground.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.Furthermore, when I fall under the power of karma and conditions,And suffer by clinging to delusive appearances as real,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, you are the essence of the King of Great Bliss,You utterly destroy the root of suffering and delusive appearances.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.When the beings of the six realms are tormented by great suffering,And especially when the sovereign and subjects of Tibet are in distress,With the intense power of devoted and respectful yearning,I pray to you without any doubt or hesitation:Oḍḍiyāna, look upon us with your unchanging compassion.I pray to Padmasambhava of Oḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that all aspirations may be spontaneously fulfilled.
